_what: StudyD216-KV025 check 2: whether the belief's PREDICTED cache state, as used in state-based pricing and in b7's feasibility check, consults the GPU-KV pool size when predicting whether a history survives
_register: OBSERVED over the source at this checkout: signatures by `inspect`, belief writers by a line census, prices by evaluating the committed functions on literals. DRY, no engine.
by_signature_note: A SIGNATURE CENSUS CANNOT SEE A READ THROUGH `self`, and one row here is exactly that case: `_pd_free_kv` shows no capacity PARAMETER and reads the declared pool off `self._pd_gpu_kv_tokens` and the occupancy off `obs.cloud`. Its entry in this table means only that the pool is not an argument; `the_one_site_that_does_read_a_pool` below is the statement about it. Every OTHER row is a module-level function whose inputs are its parameters in full, so for those the signature is the whole answer.

by_value._what: the same price under two token scales and both beliefs. The POOL is not an argument of any of them, which is why there is no pool to vary: the demonstration is that the only inputs are tokens and belief.

by_belief_shape._what: every writer of SessionRec.belief sets a one-hot dict, so predicted_tier's mass is always 1.0 and PURE_TIER_MIN_BELIEF = 0.95 can never refuse.
by_belief_shape.VERDICT: the straddling refusal is UNREACHABLE on any belief this tree can produce: the only refusal path that fires is the `cold` one

reads: obs.cloud.gpu_kv_fraction (vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc; 0.0 dry, and 0.0 live too until the D216 (2) scrape lands, because nothing read it)
the_one_site_that_does_read_a_pool.what_it_is: a CAPACITY GATE on a rebuild inside rung 4's protect-and-defer, consumed by PD.decide(free_kv_tokens=...). It is NOT the belief's survival prediction and it is rung 4's trade-off by design (D151 / D163).

what_the_predictor_uses_instead: the LAST OBSERVED OR ENACTED TIER, one-hot, carried forward unchanged. Not time, not a constant, not the pool: a stale observation standing in for a prediction. There is no survival model in the live path, so M5's step function is not implemented on the wrong variable - it is not implemented.
M5_the_variable_it_should_use: StudyENG1b / ENG1c: survival is a step function of KV ALLOCATED BEFORE RESUME - full below 1.0x of the free pool, tail-first partial 1.0 to 1.25x, total above 1.25x. D150 names this model as the one the counterfactual predicts survival from; no module in live2 implements it.
